title: Subsoil drain pipe.
officialText:
Subsoil drains shall be open-jointed, horizontally split or perforated pipe conforming to one of the
standards listed in Table 1102.5.
TABLE 1102.5
SUBSOIL DRAIN PIPE
MATERIAL STANDARD
Cast-iron pipe ASTM A 74; ASTM A 888;
CISPI 301
Polyethylene (PE ) plastic pipe ASTM F 405; CAN/CSA B
182.1; CSA B182.6; CSA
B 182.8
Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) ASTM D 2729; ASTM F
891; CSA-B182.2;
Plastic pipe (type sewer pipe,
CAN/CSA-B182.4
PS25, PS50 or PS100)a
Porous concrete pipe ASTM C 654
Vitrified clay pipe ASTM C 4; ASTM C 700
Stainless steel drainage ASME A112.3.1
systems, Type 316L
a. Limited to residential buildings five stories or less in height.
